title: The Perfect 5-Day Kerala Itinerary: Munnar Tea Hills to Alleppey Houseboat
subtitle: A seamlessly timed travel plan that balances scenic mountain mornings with relaxing backwaters.
excerpt: Detailed hour-by-hour route planning from Kochi arrival, Cheeyappara waterfalls, tea factory tours, spice tasting in Thekkady, to sleeping under the stars on an Alleppey houseboat.

contentSections.heading: Day 1 & 2: Misty Valleys of Munnar
contentSections.content: Ascend the Western Ghats into Munnar. Spend two leisurely nights admiring the Anayirangal Dam, walking through Eravikulam National Park, and visiting century-old tea factories.

contentSections.heading: Day 3: Cardamom Hills & Wildlife at Thekkady
contentSections.content: Drive through fragrant spice estates to Periyar. Enjoy an evening bamboo boat safari where wild elephants and bison often graze by the water’s edge.

contentSections.heading: Day 4: Private Houseboat Cruise in Alleppey
contentSections.content: Board your private Kettuvallam at 12:30 PM. Relish fresh Karimeen fry lunch, watch peaceful village life from your private deck, and anchor at sunset.
